paite: Maitam chin a TOUPA dingh in ka mu a, ama'n, "Kongpi bulte alin theihna ding ua alu bawkte uh khen inla, avek ua lutung ah hihzan vek in; ke'n asibangte namsau in ka that ding a; khat lel leng ataimang kei ding uh, khat lel leng asuakta het kei ding uh," achi hi.
heading: TOUPA Thukhenna

paite: Misikhua pha in paisuak mah le uh, huai a kipan ka khut in ka lakhe ding a; van ah kaltou mah le uh huai a kipan ka kaikhe ding hi.
Karmel mualvum ah bu mah le uh ka zong ding a, huai a kipan amau ka lasuk ding a, tuipi taw ah ka mitmuh louh in bu mah le uh, huai a kipan gulpi thu ka pe ding a, amau atu ding hi.
Amelmate uh ma ah sal in pai mah le uh, huai a kipan namsau thu ka pe ding a, amau asatlum ding ua; hoihna hilou in, hoihlouhna ding in atung uah ka mit ka nga ding hi.
Gam khoih a, zulsakpa TOUPA, sepaihte’ Pathian ahi ngal a; huai lai a omte tengteng alungkham ding ua; luipi bang in akhang ding ua, Aigupta lui bang in akiam nawn ding uh;
van a adantante bawl a, leitung a adantan kual bawl a, tuipi tuite sam a, leitung a sungbopa, amin TOUPA ahi.

TOUPA'N "Aw Israel suante aw, ka tung ah Ethiopia tate bang in na om kei ding ua hia? Aigupta gam a kipan Israel leh Kaphtor gam a kipan Philistia mite leh Kir gam a kipan Siria mite ka pikhe kei a hia?" achi hi.
TOUPA'N, "Ngai dih ua, Toupa PATHIAN mit gam gilou tung ah atu a, leitung a kipan ka hihmang ding a; himahleh Jakob inkote ahihse vek kei ding,” achi hi.
"Ngai dih ua, thu ka pe ding ahi; hakvang a buh ahaih bang un, nam tengteng lak ah Israel inkote ka haih ding a; himahleh tang neupen leng leitung ah ake kei ding hi.
'Ka mite mikhial tengteng, hoihlouhna in ahon delhpha kei ding a, hon pha sam kei ding,' chite namsau in asi ding uh," achi hi.
TOUPA, hiai thilhihpa'n, "Huai ni chiang in David biakbuk chim ka tungding ding a, a-awngvangte ka hu ding a; asiate ka lemtou ding a, nidanglai a a-om bang in ka lam thak ding hi, chi in;
heading: Israel Tundingna Ding

paite: Edom mun a khosuaksunte leh ka min a sap nam tengtengte aneihtheihna ding un," achi hi.

TOUPA'N, "Ngai dih ua, nite ahong tung lellel ahi, huai ni chiang in leiletmi in buh atmi adelhpha ding a, grep chil mi'n chi thehmi adelhpha ding a; tang sang in uain khum ataksak ding; mual tengteng azul ding uhi.

Huan ka mi Israelte sal a kipan ka pikik nawn ding a; khua kigawpsate abawl nawn ding ua, aluah ding uh; huan grephuante abawl ding ua, a-uain adawn ding uh; huante leng abawl ding ua, agah ane ding uhi.
Agam uah amau ka phutkip ding a, akiang ua ka piak agam ua kipan bohkhiak in a-om nawnta kei ding," TOUPA na Pathian in achi hi.
